content.text:
Three components use `QueryCell` from `apps/web/lib/QueryCell.tsx`, and one more file is a test that mocks it. They import it via `@lib/QueryCell` or a relative path:

- `apps/web/components/apps/CalendarListContainer.tsx` imports it and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/apps/installation/EventTypeConferencingAppSettings.tsx` imports it and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/modules/apps/installed/[category]/installed-category-view.tsx` imports it and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/EditLocationDialog.tsx` imports it by relative path and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/__tests__/EditLocationDialog.test.tsx` is the test file. It mocks the module with `vi.mock` and sets the mock's behavior with `QueryCell.mockImplementation`.

`packages/platform/atoms/selected-calendars/wrappers/SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx` also uses a `QueryCell`. That one comes from a separate copy at `packages/trpc/components/QueryCell.tsx` (imported as `@calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell`). It doesn't call the `apps/web/lib` version, so I left it out of the list.

<files>
apps/web/components/apps/CalendarListContainer.tsx
apps/web/components/apps/installation/EventTypeConferencingAppSettings.tsx
apps/web/modules/apps/installed/[category]/installed-category-view.tsx
apps/web/components/dialog/EditLocationDialog.tsx
apps/web/components/dialog/__tests__/EditLocationDialog.test.tsx
</files>
